name: load_well_data
description: Look up a single Volve well in the parsed DDR cache. Returns a compact summary: well_id, metadata (operator, planned_days, total_days, td_md_m, td_tvd_m, spud_date), n_daily_reports, n_activities, date_range, first_day, last_day. The full per-day payload stays server-side; downstream tools access it by well_id. Always call this first when analyzing a specific well.

name: load_fleet_data
description: Load aggregated, parsed data for all wells in the Volve fleet (~26 wells). Returns one entry per well with well_id, total_days, planned_days, td_md_m, npt_percent, on_bottom_percent, npt_days, and notable_events. Use for cross-well comparisons or 'rank wells by X' questions.

name: classify_activities
description: Tag every daily activity for the well with a category (drilling, tripping, casing, bha_handling, logging, testing, completion, workover, npt, other) and an npt_subcategory for NPT entries. Classification reads both IADC codes and free-text remarks server-side. Returns a compact summary: category_counts, category_hours, npt_subcategory_counts. Call this after load_well_data to confirm the well classifies cleanly before computing KPIs.

well_id.description: Volve well identifier. The function loads + classifies internally.

name: compute_kpis
description: Compute headline KPIs and surface anomalies for the well. Returns: total_days, planned_days, days_delta, td_md_m, td_tvd_m, npt_total_days, npt_percent, on_bottom_percent, npt_breakdown (sorted by hours descending), top_anomalies (list of {day, date, depth_md_m, description, top_subcategory, severity, remarks}). Anomalies are detected by NPT-per-day thresholds and long single stops.

well_id.description: Volve well identifier. The function loads + classifies + computes internally.

name: build_chart
description: Generate a chart specification for the UI to render with Plotly. Inputs are kept small: pass well_id for charts that need per-day data ('days_vs_depth', 'activity_breakdown'), the kpis dict for 'npt_pareto', and no input for 'fleet_npt_ranking' (loads the fleet itself).

well_id.description: Required for 'days_vs_depth' and 'activity_breakdown'. Accepted as a fallback for 'npt_pareto' when kpis is not provided.

kpis.description: Preferred input for 'npt_pareto' — the dict returned by compute_kpis. Cheaper than re-loading.

name: write_morning_memo
description: Assemble the final morning memo by filling the template at templates/morning_memo.md with provided KPIs, anomalies, and chart references. Returns the rendered Markdown ready for display. Use this only after running compute_kpis and build_chart.

anomalies.description: Top anomalies list, typically a slice of kpis.top_anomalies

charts.description: Array of chart specs from build_chart calls

recommendation.description: One specific, actionable recommendation for next spud, written in drilling supt voice. Max 50 words.

name: answer_question
description: Answer a free-text question about a well or the fleet using parsed DDR data. Use this in Q&A mode. The function returns relevant data slices the agent must then synthesize into a prose answer. If the question is out of scope (geology, reservoir, completions), the function returns an out_of_scope flag.

scope.description: Whether the question is about a single well or the full fleet.

well_id.description: Required if scope='well'. Volve well identifier.

question.description: The user's natural-language question, passed through unchanged.
